result.card: This PR extracts local address bookkeeping and self-advertisement functions from net.cpp into a dedicated LocalAddressManager class, removing unnecessary CNode dependencies as part of the net/net_processing split (#33958). It introduces no behavioral changes, aiming purely to improve modularity and enable isolated unit and fuzz testing. The change is currently in draft due to circular dependency complications, is in a dirty merge state with CI failing, and has been untouched for over 150 days.
